reason: The current official application explicitly reports an exploit affecting Wasabi's EVM deployments and states deposits and trading are paused. The catalog lifecycle policy excludes hacked frozen/recovery-only products. No supported-chain maintained replacement deployment was established; unsupported Solana is not a fallback.

lifecycleEvidence.sourceType: current official rendered application, accessed without wallet connection
lifecycleEvidence.observation: Wasabi deployments on EVM chains was exploited on April 30. Deposits and trading paused. Read latest update.
lifecycleEvidence.context: The current official marketing homepage still advertises trading and earning, but the actual linked EVM application presents this explicit exploit/paused notice. No funds were deposited and no transactions were executed.

lifecycleEvidence.observation: The docs list long and short pools on Ethereum and Base, as well as unsupported Blast, Berachain and Solana. The active app's EVM-wide exploit/pause notice overrides treating these historical deployment references alone as evidence of maintained financial operations.
limitations: No listed address was inventoried or admitted as a callable target.

scope: Primary-notice lifecycle exclusion, not a claim of team disbandment, protocol-wide permanent shutdown, full exploit forensics, live balances or future recovery status. No source ABI or persistent runtime attestation is claimed.
